items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: I played a Tom Brown's band... Gumjaw Brown played, uh, played trombone.

ctx.x: When did Tom Brown come on the scene?

I played a Tom Brown's band when, uh, I can name you the lineup of that band. They had Joe Cazard, the voice vocalist in any band. Detective Cazard, he died. Sometimes, a couple of years ago. I played a guitar. Had Joe Cazard on bass, Jules Cazard on, uh, on guitar. Had Yellow Nunes on clarinet. I played cornet. Gumjaw Brown played, uh, played trombone. And they had Rye Stevens on drums. Played, uh, Seven Magazine, the old majestic call. And Joe was the voice vocalist that any band ever had. How,
